items.detail: README.md:571-577 now reads: "`gitreins` resolves through the pipx shim at `~/.local/bin/gitreins` — do NOT prefix PATH with a repo venv. (4) Links intact: 28 markdown links, 0 empty targets, and all 19 relative links resolve on disk (missing: []).
